name: @playform/ets-hook-dsh-graph-suggester
description: The graph-suggester hook: a DeepSeek Harness plugin that upgrades the suggester family's candidate list from paths and globs to the CONNECTED COMPONENT around the symbol. When the model reads or greps a source file, the hook asks the workspace v4.1 graph service for the code-block neighborhood of that file (the definition, the callers, the tests, the doc block) and prepends ONE labeled additionalContexts notice naming it; a grep for a package name falls back to the static Sibling intent. The graph service shape is declared in this package's own Interface (self-contained PoC: no import from sibling workspace packages); when the service is absent or fails, the hook abstains with a `graph unavailable` ledger line - a wrong target set costs more than a missing one. Deterministic classifier, no LLM in the hot path. Plan: Documentation/Plans/SEARCH-SUGGESTER-PLUGIN.md (sections 8, 9.2) + Documentation/Plans/Workspace-Family/WAVE-1-BRIEF.md (the graph contract the hook consumes).
